metadata.description: The oh-my-pi add-on set: token economy, inline terminal images, DeepSeek vision, and the updater that keeps all three current.

plugins.name: omp-suite
plugins.description: Startup update check and /omp-addons command for the whole set. Reports newer versions of the pack, the terminal-image patch and the DeepSeek vision override, and drives omp's own marketplace upgrade.

plugins.name: supreme-token-saver
plugins.description: Nine token-saving knobs behind six presets (off to ultra): caveman replies, RTK shell compaction, ponytail code minimalism, auto-RTK, native read/compress/prune/threshold dials, and one status row.

plugins.name: terminal-images
plugins.description: Inline images in the omp TUI on Windows Terminal: forces the sixel protocol and patches the composer and transcript surfaces so pasted images render as pictures instead of chips.

plugins.name: deepseek-flash-vision
plugins.description: Declares deepseek-flash as an image-capable model in omp and stops the transport from stripping image parts, so an attached screenshot reaches DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
